abstract: The intrinsic Jacobian singular scheme of the standard chordal cubic threefold jumps from the reduced rational normal quartic in odd characteristic to the non-split genus-five balanced canonical ribbon in characteristic two.
integrity: Exact symbolic chart proof; finite field point enumerations only as consistency checks. No independent audit or publication certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: The balanced ribbon and its quadrics are already known; the contribution is their precise identification with the chordal cubic intrinsic Jacobian scheme and the modular Hilbert-polynomial jump. This identification follows from combining closely related published equations and may have an implicit antecedent. Nonreduced arithmetic primary components beyond the special fiber are not classified.
title: Characteristic-two canonical ribbon in the Jacobian scheme of the chordal cubic
